decision: Current $1.50 cap is infeasible: it buys less than the measured V13 session duration. Preserve three captures and 3600-second session; require at least the rounded-up $4.27 conditional all-in authority after director admission.

phase_model.allocation: one fresh VM and one verified resident checkpoint
phase_model.checkpoint_reuse: Allowed only across the three fresh server-process captures while storage identity, model revision, tokenizer binding, and 48-shard verification marker remain identical; otherwise stop.
